# Hermes — Operating Platform for AI Voice Agencies

Hermes is the operating platform AI voice agencies use to run multi-tenant workspaces,
keep their phone numbers, hit transparent margins, and stay TCPA-compliant.

Public launch: June 6, 2026. Private beta started May 7, 2026.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://buildwithhermes.com/): The operating platform for AI voice agencies
- [For Operators](https://buildwithhermes.com/operators): For voice-AI agency operators
- [For Businesses](https://buildwithhermes.com/business): For local businesses using Hermes
- [For Creators](https://buildwithhermes.com/creators): For educators and template creators
- [Pricing](https://buildwithhermes.com/pricing): Transparent operator and business pricing
- [About](https://buildwithhermes.com/about): Built by operators, for operators
- [Manifesto](https://buildwithhermes.com/manifesto): Why an operating layer for AI voice agencies
- [Founders' Beta](https://buildwithhermes.com/beta): 40 seats. Founding rate locks at signup.

## Brand facts

- Founded by 4 co-founders: Alfredo Romero (CEO), Nico Lopez (CTO), Leandro Clerf (Head of Design), Tobias Guerrero (Head of AI)
- Pricing: Starter $149/mo, Business $399/mo, Agency $699/mo, Pro custom. Flat $0.24/min overage.
- No BYOK by design. Hermes manages upstream voice/LLM relationships.
- Multi-workspace, white-label demo pages (CNAME-bound), built-in CRM, transparent billing, NEXQA pre-publish validation
- TCPA-aware. A2P 10DLC supported (included on Agency plan and above)
- Public launch: June 6, 2026
- Discord community: https://discord.gg/myysCGQeQY
- X: https://x.com/buildwithhermes
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/buildwithhermes/

## Tagline

"By builders, for builders."
